question: What is the capital city of Australia?

subquestions: What is the capital city of Australia?

observations.content:
[1] Canberra - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Canberra
    On 1 January 1901, federation of the colonies of Australia was achieved. The capital city was founded and formally named as Canberra in 1913. Unusual among Australian cities, it is an entirely planned city, grounded in a design by American architects Walter Burley Griffin and Marion Mahony Griffin.

[2] List of Australian capital cities - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Australian_capital_cities
    There are eight capital cities in Australia, each of which functions as the seat of government for its state or territory. One of these, Canberra, is also the national capital.

[3] Canberra | History, Map, Population, Climate, & Facts ...
    https://www.britannica.com/place/Canberra
    2 days ago · Canberra, federal capital of the Commonwealth of Australia. It occupies part of the Australian Capital Territory, in southern Australia, and is about 150 miles (240 km) southwest of Sydney.

[4] What Is the Capital City of Australia?
    https://www.insideaustraliatravel.com/faqs/australia-capital-city
    Jun 9, 2026 · The capital city of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney or Melbourne. Canberra is located in the Australian Capital Territory, inland from the east coast and surrounded by New South Wales.

[5] What is the Capital of Australia? Canberra - Countryaah.com
    https://www.countryaah.com/australia-faqs/
    Jun 2, 2019 · Canberra, the capital city of Australia, is located in the southeastern part of the country, in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT). Unlike many national capitals, Canberra was specifically chosen and designed to be the country’s capital, rather than being an existing city.

steps.note: The capital city of Australia is **Canberra**. (Sources: [S1], [S3])
